The company markets its products through consumers, independent manufacturing representatives, third-party distributors, and retailers. The company was formerly known as SPX Corporation and changed its name to SPX Technologies, Inc. in August 2022. SPX Technologies, Inc. is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
